description: Source code for the AlienBuildableComponent class, managing alien buildable entities in the game, including damage handling, death, explosion, and creep effects.

classes.name: AlienBuildableComponent
classes.description: Manages alien buildable entities, handling damage, death, explosion, and creep effects.

methods.name: HandleDamage
methods.description: Handles damage to the buildable, triggers pain animation if constructed.

methods.name: Think
methods.description: Per-frame logic, affecting nearby humans with creep effects.

methods.name: HandleDie
methods.description: Handles death of the buildable, sets up explosion timing.

methods.name: Blast
methods.description: Executes explosion effects, damages nearby humans, rewards attackers, and updates state.

methods.name: CreepRecede
methods.description: Handles creep receding effect after explosion.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes the buildable entity from the game.

methods.name: GetBlastDelay
methods.description: Generates a random delay for the blast timer.
